title: The Long Atlas
author: Ines Blackwood
blurb: Ines Ashgrove, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
